ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a phase diagram, with the vertical axis labeled P and the horizontal axis labeled T. Several phase boundary lines converge near lower temperature and lower pressure; label w is located on the left side of the left, steep boundary line and in the low-temperature region, x is located in the middle region, y is located in the right high-temperature region, and z is near the vicinity of the triple point. Reasoning: In a standard P-T phase diagram, the solid phase is usually located on the low-temperature side, that is, on the left side of the solid-liquid boundary line, and in the region near/above the sublimation curve. The labeled region in the figure that satisfies this positional feature is w. Therefore, the region corresponding to the solid phase is w.
